d:
Rahul Subramanian loves Bangalore. Watch his take on his favourite city - he talks about everything from the airport to traffic to autowaalas to the startup culture in his city
Rahul is an MBA-Brand Manager turned Standup comedian who is making the world funnier, one joke at a time. Check out his social media for you daily dose of funny
